00047 DiskOutUGenInternal::DiskOutUGenInternal(File const& file, UGen const& input, bool overwriteExisitingFile, int bitDepth) throw()
00048 : ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(NumInputs, input.getNumChannels()-1),
00049  audioFormatWriter(0),
00050  bufferData(0),
00051  numInputChannels(input.getNumChannels())
00052 {
00053  ugen_assert(bitDepth >= 16);
00054  
00055  inputs[Input] = input;
00056  
00057  bufferData = new float*[numInputChannels];
00058  memset(bufferData, 0, numInputChannels * sizeof(float*));
00059  
00060  File outputFile(file);
00061  
00062  if(outputFile.getFileExtension().isEmpty())
00063   outputFile = outputFile.withFileExtension(T("wav"));
00064  
00065  if(overwriteExisitingFile == true && outputFile.exists())
00066   outputFile.deleteFile();
00067  else if(outputFile.exists())
00068  {
00069   ugen_assertfalse;
00070   return;
00071  }
00072  
00073  if(outputFile.hasFileExtension(".wav"))
00074  {
00075   WavAudioFormat wavAudioFormat;
00076   FileOutputStream* fileOutputStream = outputFile.createOutputStream();
00077   
00078   if(fileOutputStream)
00079    audioFormatWriter = wavAudioFormat.createWriterFor(fileOutputStream, 
00080                   UGen::getSampleRate(), 
00081                   numInputChannels, 
00082                   bitDepth, 0, 0);
00083  }
00084  else if(outputFile.hasFileExtension(".aif") 
00085    || outputFile.hasFileExtension(".aiff"))
00086  {
00087   AiffAudioFormat aiffAudioFormat;
00088   FileOutputStream* fileOutputStream = outputFile.createOutputStream();
00089   
00090   if(fileOutputStream)
00091    audioFormatWriter = aiffAudioFormat.createWriterFor(fileOutputStream, 
00092                 UGen::getSampleRate(), 
00093                 numInputChannels, 
00094                 bitDepth, 0, 0);
00095  }
00096   
00097 }
00098 
00099 DiskOutUGenInternal::~DiskOutUGenInternal() throw()
00100 {
00101  delete audioFormatWriter;
00102  delete [] bufferData;

00104 
00105 void DiskOutUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00106 {
00107  if(audioFormatWriter == 0) return;
00108  
00109  int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00110  
00111  for(int i = 0; i < numInputChannels; i++)
00112  {
00113   float *inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, i);
00114   float *outputSamples = proxies[i]->getSampleData();
00115   memcpy(outputSamples, inputSamples, blockSize * sizeof(float));
00116   bufferData[i] = inputSamples;
00117  }
00118   
00119  // should really buffer this data in larger chunks that the block size before writing
00120  AudioSampleBuffer audioSampleBuffer(bufferData, numInputChannels, blockSize);
00121  audioSampleBuffer.writeToAudioWriter(audioFormatWriter, 0, blockSize);
00122 }

00140 void DiskOut::initWithJuceFile(File const& file, UGen const& input, bool overwriteExisitingFile, int bitDepth) throw()
00141 {
00142  DiskOutUGenInternal* internal;
00143  
00144  if(file.isDirectory()) 
00145  {
00146   internal = new DiskOutUGenInternal(file.getChildFile(getFileNameWithTimeIdentifier(T("DiskOut"))), 
00147              input, 
00148              overwriteExisitingFile, 
00149              bitDepth);
00150  }
00151  else
00152  {
00153   internal = new DiskOutUGenInternal(file, input, overwriteExisitingFile, bitDepth);
00154  }
00155  
00156  initInternal(input.getNumChannels());
00157  generateFromProxyOwner(internal);
00158 }
